_blurb: Partner + ücretsiz değişiklik, yedek sözleşme yok

decisions.target: Passengers booked on Kestrel flights to or from Orlando or Philadelphia between December 21 and December 27

actions.action: Rebooking deal with a partner airline for 2 disrupted weeks
Free changes and cancellations for bookings in a 2-week window

decisions.message: Kestrel Air: a 48-hour ground handling strike is planned at Orlando and Philadelphia on Dec 22-23, and flights on those days may be late or canceled. If you can travel on another day, move your flight now for free in the app: Dec 21 and Dec 24 still have seats. If you keep your flight and it is canceled, we will rebook you on Kestrel or a partner airline, or refund you in full if you prefer.
decisions.why:
Own seats in week 8 are 97% booked, so moving people early and a partner airline are the cheapest protection.
We skip the backup contract and keep $2.5M in reserve for surprises.
An honest early warning is what passengers remember.
